cd /workspace/tmp && cat > feat.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
MOD = 1<<64
def fp(b):
    h=0
    for c in b: h=(h*257+c+1)%MOD
    return {'n':len(b),'h':'%016x'%h}

def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    if p.returncode: print('EXIT', p.stderr.decode()[:600]); sys.exit(1)
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

def check(name, got, want):
    if json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True) != json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True):
        print('FAIL', name); print(' got', json.dumps(got)[:400]); print(' want', json.dumps(want)[:400])
    else: print('PASS', name)

# 1. expression template in a channel with a length body
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[["big","b'ab' * 100"]],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{ 'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\nContent-Length: 200\\r\\n\\r\\n' + big }}"}]}]}
out = run(doc)
ch = out['channels'][0]
check('expr length body', [ch['bytes'], ch['requests'][0]['body'], ch['error'], ch['committed']],
      [fp(b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 200\r\n\r\n"+b'ab'*100), fp(b'ab'*100), None, [1]])

# 2. huge repeated body (1e9 bytes) - must not materialize
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[["big","b'x' * 1000000000"]],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{ 'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\nContent-Length: 1000000000\\r\\n\\r\\n' + big }}"}]}]}
out = run(doc)
ch = out['channels'][0]
want_body = fp(b'')
h=0
for c in b'x'*1: h=(h*257+c+1)%MOD
# fingerprint of 1e9 repeats of 'x': h = h_x repeated
def rep(h,l,n):
    if n==0: return 0
    if n==1: return h
    half=n//2; r=rep(h,l,half); r=(r*pow(257,l*half,MOD)+r)%MOD
    if n&1: r=(r*pow(257,l,MOD)+h)%MOD
    return r
check('huge body', [ch['requests'][0]['body']['n'], ch['requests'][0]['end'], ch['error']],
      [1000000000, 5+len('Content-Length: 1000000000')+2+21+1000000000- 0, None])

# 3. incomplete length body
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[["big","b'x' * 3"]],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\nContent-Length: 10\\r\\n\\r\\n{{ big }}"}]}]}
out = run(doc)
check('incomplete length', out['channels'][0]['error'], {"kind":"incomplete","offset":0})
check('incomplete length requests', [r['end'] for r in out['channels'][0]['requests']], [])

# 4. chunked with a huge chunk
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[["big","b'q' * 100000"]],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{ 'POST /x HTTP/1.1\\r\\nhost: h\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: CHUNKED\\r\\n\\r\\n186a0\\r\\n' + big + '\\r\\n0\\r\\n\\r\\n' }}"}]}]}
out = run(doc)
r = out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('chunked huge', [r['body'], r['framing'], r['host'], out['channels'][0]['error']],
      [fp(b'q'*100000), 'chunked', fp(b'h'), None])

# 5. random tokens in templates
doc = {"seed":"sd","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"A<<random_string>>B<<random_string>>"}]}]}
import hashlib
def tok(seed, coord, occ):
    return hashlib.sha256(('%s/%s/%d'%(seed,coord,occ)).encode()).hexdigest()[:20].encode()
out = run(doc)
check('random tokens', out['channels'][0]['bytes'], fp(b'A'+tok('sd','channel/0/part/0/data',0)+b'B'+tok('sd','channel/0/part/0/data',1)))

# 6. random tokens per template occurrence independent
doc = {"seed":"sd","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":5,
 "cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x<<random_string>>"}],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
 "events":[{"at":0,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"y<<random_string>>","end":True}],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"z<<random_string>>"}]}]}
out = run(doc)
check('random coords', [out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], out['channels'][0]['bytes']],
      [1+20, fp(b'z'+tok('sd','channel/0/part/0/data',0))])
# note payload_bytes includes only the data bytes
check('random event', out['cases'][0]['response_body']['n'], 1+20)

# 7. definitions referencing earlier, slicing at multi-byte boundaries
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[["u","'héllo'"],["s","u[0:4]"]],"timeout_ms":5,"cases":[],"events":[],
 "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{ s + s }}" }]}]}
out = run(doc)
check('slice utf8', out['channels'][0]['bytes'], fp('héllo'.encode()[:4]*2))

# 8. expression in frame headers
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[["n","'nam'"],["v","'val' * 2"]],"timeout_ms":5,
 "cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["{{ n }}","{{ v }}"],["k","w"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
 "events":[{"at":0,"kind":"close"}],"channels":[]}
out = run(doc)
check('expr headers', [out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], out['cases'][0]['request_frames']], [3+6+1+1, 1])

# 9. headers_kv member order preserved
doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":5,
 "cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","headers_kv":{"z":"1","a":"2","m":"3"},"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
 "events":[{"at":0,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[],"end":True}],"channels":[]}
out = run(doc)
sent = out['cases'][0]['sent']
def act(pairs):
    o = (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'H'+len(pairs).to_bytes(8,'big')
    for k,v in pairs: o += len(k).to_bytes(8,'big')+k+len(v).to_bytes(8,'big')+v
    return o+bytes([1])
check('headers_kv order', sent, fp(act([(b'z',b'1'),(b'a',b'2'),(b'm',b'3')])))
